title: Drithnak the Exiled
summary: Drithnak creates egg sacs during a fight that must stay inside its area.
overview: Drithnak creates egg sacs during a fight that must stay inside its area.

sections.title: Encounter strategy
bullets: Keep the boss near its encounter position to avoid the out-of-bounds response.
Expect egg sacs on a recurring timer and have someone watch their locations.
Control the resulting pressure while maintaining steady boss damage.
